CBSE • CLASS 10 • SCIENCE

Unit I · Chemical Substances

25 marks. Reactions and equations, acids bases salts, metals and non-metals, carbon compounds.

  • Ch 1 · Chemical Reactions and EquationsBalancing, the five reaction types, corrosion and rancidity.
  • Ch 2 · Acids, Bases and SaltspH scale, indicators, and the four commercially important salts.
  • Ch 3 · Metals and Non-metalsPhysical properties, the reactivity series and extraction of metals.
  • Ch 4 · Carbon and its CompoundsCovalent bonding, homologous series, and ethanol and ethanoic acid.
  • Balancing equations and the reaction types are asked every single year.
